memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: from Ephraim, Elishama son of Ammihud; from Manasseh, Gamaliel son of Pedahzur; from Benjamin, Abidan son of Gideoni; from Dan, Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai; from Asher, Pagiel son of Okran; from Gad, Eliasaph son of Deuel; from Naphtali, Ahira son of Enan. These were the men appointed from the community, the leaders of their ancestral tribes. They were the heads of the clans of Israel. - Num 1:9-16 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Here is a list of names most of us have never heard in a sermon. They were not famous. They performed no recorded miracles. Yet God knew each one, chose each one, and gave each one a place of trust in His people.

It is a comfort to know that God's work is carried forward not only by the well-known heroes of faith, but by ordinary people faithfully doing their part. These tribal leaders will never be household names, but God recorded their names carefully in His Word. That says something about how He values quiet faithfulness.

You may feel that your service goes unnoticed — the prayers no one hears, the kindness no one sees, the daily faithfulness that never gets applause. But God notices. He is the God who writes down ordinary names.

The Bible tells us that the names of God's people are written in the Lamb's book of life (Rev 21:27). If you belong to Christ, your name is recorded in a far greater list than any census — recorded by grace, secured forever.

Serve faithfully today, even in the small and unseen things. Nothing done for God is ever wasted or forgotten.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you serve for applause, or out of love for God?
- How does it encourage you that God records ordinary faithfulness?
- What quiet act of faithfulness can you offer God today?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, I may never be famous, but I want to be faithful. Thank You that You see and remember even the smallest things done for You. Amen.
